controles.affirmation: Depuis mars 2023, quatre autorites de la concurrence (UE, Royaume-Uni, Suisse, Mexique) enquetent sur IFF pour entente potentielle sur les prix du parfum (hook)
controles.verbatim_source: IFF understands the EC, CMA and the Swiss Competition Commission are investigating potential anticompetitive conduct as it relates to IFF's fragrance businesses. ... The Mexican Competition Commission has also announced that it is investigating potential anticompetitive conduct in the fragrance and fragrance ingredients industries.
controles.correction_proposee: Trois autorites (UE, CMA britannique, Commission suisse) enquetent sur des pratiques anticoncurrentielles potentielles visant les activites parfum d'IFF ; la Commission mexicaine enquete sur l'industrie du parfum et des ingredients de parfum, sans que le document nomme IFF. Remplacer 'entente sur les prix' par 'pratiques anticoncurrentielles potentielles' : le filing ne parle jamais de price-fixing pour les enquetes reglementaires (seules les class actions civiles allèguent une entente sur les prix). Le corps de l'ATT est correct, seul le hook derape.

controles.affirmation: 43 M$ verses pour regler trois recours collectifs americains : acheteurs directs 26 M$ (novembre 2025), acheteurs indirects 6 M$ (juin 2026), utilisateurs finaux 11 M$ (mai 2026) ; plainte du 27 janvier 2026 reglee sans paiement
controles.verbatim_source: IFF then contributed $26 million to a settlement fund ... IFF contributed $6 million to a settlement with indirect purchaser plaintiffs on June 25, 2026, and contributed $11 million to a settlement with end-user plaintiffs on May 6, 2026 ... the Company recognized a total provision of $43 million within 'Selling and Administrative Expenses' ... On January 27, 2026, an additional class action complaint was filed in the District of New Jersey ... This settlement will not require a payment from the Company.

controles.affirmation: Enquetes ouvertes en 2026 a Singapour et en Inde sur les pratiques d'emploi dans l'industrie du parfum
controles.verbatim_source: During 2026, additional investigations have been initiated in Singapore and India relating to employment practices in the fragrance industry. As with the other investigations, IFF is cooperating with the regulators in these investigations.

controles.affirmation: En preparant ses comptes du deuxieme trimestre 2026, la direction a identifie des erreurs de comptabilisation de l'impot qui l'ont conduite a reviser les etats financiers du troisieme trimestre 2025 et de l'exercice 2025
controles.verbatim_source: In preparing the Consolidated Financial Statements as of and for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, Management identified certain income tax-related adjustments that primarily relate to the understatement of income tax expense due to errors in the accounting for transfer pricing ... In preparing the Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended December 31, 2025, management identified an additional error related to tax expense on business disposals that affects the interim consolidated financial statements for the three months and six months ended June 30, 2025 and nine months ended September 30, 2025
controles.correction_proposee: Les erreurs ont ete identifiees lors de la preparation des comptes du TROISIEME TRIMESTRE 2025 (et une erreur supplementaire lors de la preparation des comptes annuels 2025), pas du deuxieme trimestre 2026. Ce sont les periodes anterieures (dont le premier semestre 2025) qui ont ete revisees, pas 'le troisieme trimestre 2025 et l'exercice 2025'. Reformuler : 'En preparant ses comptes du troisieme trimestre 2025, la direction a identifie des erreurs de comptabilisation de l'impot qui l'ont conduite a reviser des periodes anterieures ; une erreur supplementaire a ete identifiee lors de la cloture annuelle 2025.'

controles.affirmation: Goodwill (8 145 M$) + autres incorporels (3 732 M$) = 11 877 M$, soit 84% des capitaux propres totaux du groupe (14 153 M$) au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Total Shareholders' Equity | 13,976 | 14,154 (colonnes : June 30, 2026 | December 31, 2025). Goodwill 8,145 ; Other intangible assets, net 3,732.
controles.correction_proposee: Le montant 14 153 M$ n'existe pas dans le filing : les capitaux propres au 30/06/2026 sont de 13 976 M$ (14 154 M$ etant le chiffre au 31/12/2025). Le ratio correct est 11 877 / 13 976 = 85% (et non 84%). Corriger le chiffre et le ratio.

controles.affirmation: Une depreciation de goodwill a deja ete comptabilisee deux annees de suite, 34 M$ au premier semestre 2025 et 64 M$ en 2026 sur la partie cedee du segment Food Ingredients
controles.verbatim_source: Compte de resultat : 'Impairment of goodwill | — | — | — | 34' (T2 2026 | T2 2025 | 6M 2026 | 6M 2025) = aucune depreciation en 2026. ; 'The impairment of goodwill of $34 million in the 2025 period represents the impairment of goodwill attributable to the portion of the Food Ingredients reporting unit that is NOT included within the Food Ingredients or SCL disposal groups.' ; Le '$64 million goodwill impairment charge' est la note (1) du tableau 'Divestiture of the Pharma Solutions Disposal Group' au 1er mai 2025.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer la mention 'deux annees de suite' et '64 M$ en 2026'. Les deux charges sont rattachees a 2025 : 34 M$ concernent la partie du Food Ingredients NON cedee, et 64 M$ concernent le goodwill du groupe de cession Pharma Solutions. Aucune depreciation de goodwill n'est comptabilisee au premier semestre 2026.

controles.affirmation: Cessions : Food Ingredients a CVC annonce le 29 mai 2026, cloture attendue fin T2 2027, 10% conserves ; groupe SCL ; CitraSource le 23 juin 2026 ; Pharma Solutions en mai 2025
controles.verbatim_source: On May 29, 2026, the Company announced it had entered into an agreement to sell its Food Ingredients business ... to funds advised by CVC Capital Partners ... the Company has chosen to retain a 10% minority equity interest ... The transaction is expected to close by the end of the second quarter of 2027 ; On June 23, 2026, the Company entered into a definitive agreement to divest the CitraSource business ; The Company completed the divestiture [Pharma Solutions] on May 1, 2025
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune correction requise. Omission a signaler toutefois : le meme 10-Q annonce une cession supplementaire le 20 juillet 2026 (Botanical Extracts, Vitamins & Minerals, Food Enhancement) avec 'a pre-tax loss on the sale in the range of approximately $200 million to $300 million' - element materiel absent de l'ATT.

controles.affirmation: Taux d'imposition effectif de 48,4% au T2 2026 (+74 pts), marge nette a 2,6% (-28,6 pts), effet de comparaison avec un gain sur extinction de dette de 488 M$ au T2 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Income from continuing operations before taxes 64 | 438 ; Provision (benefit) for income taxes 31 | (112) ; Gain on extinguishment of debt — | (488) ; Net income (loss) 51 | 599 ; Net sales 1,954 | 1,919 (calculs : 31/64 = 48,4% ; -112/438 = -25,6% ; 51/1 954 = 2,6% ; 599/1 919 = 31,2%)

controles.affirmation: CA publie T1 2026 en baisse de 4% (comparable +3%) ; CA publie FY2025 en baisse de 5% (comparable +2%)
controles.verbatim_source: Reported net sales for the first quarter were $2.74 billion, a decrease of 4% versus the prior-year period ... currency neutral sales increased 3% ; Reported net sales for the full year were $10.89 billion, a decrease of (5)% compared to the prior year ... currency neutral sales increased 2% (_digest.txt)

controles.affirmation: L'investisseur qui lit uniquement la ligne 'Net sales' voit un groupe qui reduit son chiffre d'affaires depuis plusieurs trimestres consecutifs
controles.verbatim_source: Sales in the second quarter of 2026 increased $35 million, or 2% on a reported basis, to $1.954 billion compared to $1.919 billion in the 2025 period. (10-Q T2 2026, cite par l'ATT elle-meme)
controles.correction_proposee: Le trimestre le plus recent disponible a la date d'arret de l'ATT (04/08/2026) affiche un CA publie EN HAUSSE de 2%. Reformuler au passe et borner : 'Sur FY2025 et le T1 2026, le CA publie a recule (-5% puis -4%) alors que la croissance comparable etait positive ; le T2 2026 marque un retour a +2% publie.'

controles.affirmation: Dette totale 5 699 M$ au 30 juin 2026, en baisse vs 5 992 M$ un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: NOTE 14. DEBT - '(DOLLARS IN MILLIONS) | Effective Interest Rate | June 30, 2026 | December 31, 2025' ... 'Total debt | 5,699 | 5,992' ; 'Less: Short-term borrowings | (964) | (1,254)'
controles.correction_proposee: 5 992 M$ est le montant au 31 DECEMBRE 2025, soit six mois plus tot, et non un an. Remplacer 'un an plus tot' par 'six mois plus tot (31 decembre 2025)'.

controles.affirmation: Ratio dette nette / EBITDA ajuste de credit de 2,51x, sous le covenant de 3,75x, periode de relief de covenant supprimee en juin 2025
controles.verbatim_source: At June 30, 2026, our net debt to credit adjusted EBITDA ratio was 2.51 to 1.0 ; ... shall not exceed 3.75x thereafter ; On June 25, 2025, the Company, with its lenders, entered into the Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement ... removed the financial covenant relief period and associated restrictions.
